MX-37
MANUAL TRANSAXLE (C56) ~ OUTPUT SHAFT
8. REMOVE FRONT BEARING INNER RACE
Using SST and a press, remove the front bearing inner race,
SST 09950-00020
NOTICE:
When replacing the front bearing inner race, replace the
output shaft front bearing along with it.
HINT:
Support the output shaft by hand so that it will not be dropped
off.
9. DISASSEMBLE REVERSE GEAR ASSEMBLY
{a) Remove the reverse gear from the No. 1 clutch hub.
(b) Remove the 3 No. 1 shifting keys and No. 1 shifting key
springs from the No. 1 clutch hub.
